reviews.text: Super professional! She not only gives you guidelines on how to train your furry friends, but she also explains everything step by step, explaining why we should do it that way. Besides the weekly visits, she also provides support whenever you need it. She's a great help in training, always prioritizing the well-being of our little ones. Coco has gained not only a trainer, but a new friend!

Fofi is an incredible professional. It's amazing how she can understand what your dog is going through with just a look, and she helps you, as their guardian, to create a much healthier and more fulfilling relationship so that you're both happier. I highly recommend working with her.

We had a great experience with Federica. She not only helped us understand Tilo better and create healthier habits for him, but she also helped us get to know each other better as a team, and we've managed to strengthen our bond considerably. Highly trustworthy and highly recommended!

I have no words to thank Fofi enough for her patience and, above all, her expertise. She is a very knowledgeable person, and it's clear she loves what she does. Thanks to her, I can better understand my Bodeguero, Selva, and we're improving little by little each day.

She taught me that being a multi-species family also means respecting other living beings, not just constantly demanding obedience. Thanks to her techniques and the spirit of her gentle method, focused on Selva's well-being, we've been able to greatly improve our walks, as she's an adopted dog who suffers from reactivity. She's undoubtedly much better now, and I'm sure Selva appreciates it as much as I do.

We are delighted with Fofi's work. With his patience, he has helped us understand our dog's behavior and improve our relationship with him. We appreciate his follow-up and the professionalism he demonstrated from beginning to end. Thank you very much.

I adopted Canela a few months ago, a rescued dog who came to me with a lot of fears. I honestly didn't know how to do it right; no matter how good our intentions are, it's not easy, and it's important to ask for help. We started with Fofi from the first week we had Canela. He helped us establish routines and gradually overcome her fears. Canela has changed dramatically and continues to improve. Fofi has helped us both immensely. Thank you so much!

Thanks to Fofi's positive reinforcement training, Maxi has gained a lot of confidence. She has taught us to understand him better and given him the tools to be a more balanced dog. A true professional!
We've had Fofi for 6 months now, and he's amazing in every way! He's helped us so much with our pet, understanding and training him! 🥰 Highly recommended!! Thank you, Fofi! …

We booked 10 training sessions for our dog, and we're really happy with the difference. From the first session to the last, the difference was noticeable. She gave me lots of guidelines for working with him every day and taught me how to understand my dog's needs. I recommend her 100%.

Thank you so much for your help and patience 😀

A very good experience. The trainer treated my 6-month-old dog very well, both her and us, explaining how to train her correctly.

She gave us a lot of information about her breed, how to understand it, and how to raise it. She was very patient and dedicated.

Thank you so much!

Impeccable service. Our dog has learned about self-control, commands, and routines. There has definitely been a before and after in her development. We are very happy.
Fofi has been excellent with us and with her. We highly recommend their services.

Excellent service. They've been a huge help with our dog. It's a very professional service at a fair price. I'd like to highlight:
- The trainer's punctuality.

The excellent and friendly treatment, both towards us and our pet.

The flexibility in addressing the issues we needed to work on most.

Their adaptability to our schedules.

Highly recommended.
The change in our dog in just a few sessions is incredible! We can only thank Federica; she does an excellent job and helps improve everything the animal needs. A 10 out of 10! 100% recommended!

Federica is very professional and friendly! We've been working with her on our dog's behavior for a few months now, and he's improved a lot and she's given us so much peace of mind. We'll definitely continue to use her services and highly recommend her.

Fofi is wonderful. Always with a smile and enormous patience, she taught us how to understand what Lur needed and how to work on it. Everything was done with respect and understanding. In just a few sessions and with consistent work on our part, always guided by her, we noticed a huge change in Lur, and what more can I say? He ADORES her. Thank you for everything!

We adopted a podenco about a year ago who had been mistreated by her former owner and had a phobia of people, noises, and the street.

We decided to take a chance on Federica after the recommendation of the shelter where we adopted her.
Federica's professionalism and care have been outstanding; she always guided us on the right path to follow in these cases. She left no stone unturned.

I highly recommend Federica to anyone who encounters inappropriate behavior in dogs and doesn't know what to do.

Thank you so much for helping us improve our dog's quality of life.

You can really see how much she loves dogs. She's helping us a lot with training our dog, using love and, above all, understanding her so we don't get frustrated in difficult situations. A 10 out of 10!

I contacted Federica to work on some of my dog's behaviors, such as separation anxiety, reactivity towards certain dogs, and several other fears. I purchased a package of 5 sessions, and I've learned a great deal, receiving many tips, exercises, and recommendations to continue working and improving at home. Federica has a perfect understanding of my dog, and with a lot of patience, I've noticed very positive changes in just a few sessions. Furthermore, after each session, Federica sends me a written report with videos and step-by-step instructions for the exercises I should continue practicing, as she has a wealth of knowledge and information to share. I've loved her working method, which prioritizes the dog's well-being, understanding the reasons behind her behaviors, and is very patient and always uses positive reinforcement!

Very patient with animals and people, and caring. Always attentive to what our furry friends are doing, sending reports with guidelines to follow before each session and addressing any questions that arise.
Fofi is wonderful and very, very professional. I love watching her work with Bubú, and he is so happy when he comes... I recommend her 100%...

We went to Federica after a failed attempt with another trainer who didn't meet our expectations.
I searched for her on Google and started following her on social media. I contacted her shortly after; everything I'd seen on her Instagram seemed very interesting, and I wanted Trufa to enjoy her walks. We opted for the 5-session package, and I can only say we're thrilled! We've learned so much from her; it's clear she loves animals, and her methods are entirely positive. We finished our last session a few weeks ago, but even so, I sometimes ask her questions, and she inquires about Trufa. We recommend her 100%, without a doubt!

I wanted to thank Fofi here, in addition to doing so privately. We've been working with her for several months now, and although we haven't seen each other in a couple of months (we're working with ethologists), I still ask her questions, and she still asks about my dog. She addresses any concerns I have (reactivity, resource guarding, separation anxiety, etc.) with a thousand details almost every week. Whenever I send her videos showing progress, she's so happy for us. My dog ​​also has food intolerances, and Fofi gave us the contact information for a nutritionist I loved, who kept her up-to-date. She always prioritizes the animals' well-being. Thank you, thank you, and thank you from the bottom of my heart for continuing to be there and for being the foundation of a team of professionals from different fields. It's so wonderful to know that my dog ​​and I have such a fantastic professional always there for us whenever we need her and who always believes in us.

Federica is a lovely and very professional woman. Her love and dedication to her work and our furry friends are evident. My little one and I learned so much. The exercises were clear and effective. Positive reinforcement training.
We are delighted with Federica, how she personalizes the sessions to the dog's needs, and the gradual exercises she guides us through. We are very happy.
